name: pumi-dsh
description: DeepSeek Harness agents in a pane of their own: each pane is one `dsh --profile sdk` runtime, driven over its JSON-RPC stdio protocol and drawn as a chat. The harness keeps its own tools, sandbox, plugins and sessions.

binary.label: Harness
binary.desc: The `dsh` executable a pane runs. Empty: the first `dsh` on the machine, else the Desktop install's own launcher.

home.label: Harness home
home.desc: `DSH_HOME` for a pane: where its profiles, credentials and sessions live. Empty: `DSH_HOME` in the environment, else `~/.dsh`. An API key saved in the harness's Settings is reused from here.

profile.label: Profile
profile.desc: The harness profile a pane boots. `sdk` (the full agent over SDK stdio) or `sdk-minimal` (a shell, image reading and compaction only).

provider.label: Provider
provider.desc: The model route a pane runs on: `deepseek-account` (the signed-in DeepSeek account), `deepseek-official` (an API key), `openrouter` once Gateway routes declares it, or any route the profile mounts.

model.label: Model
model.desc: The model id that route resolves: `deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro`, or an OpenRouter id such as `deepseek/deepseek-flash-latest`.

providers.label: Gateway routes
providers.desc: Routes to add through pi-ai, as its own `providers` dictionary — for example {"openrouter": {"apiKeyEnv": "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"}}. Empty: the profile's routes alone. A route pi-ai does not ship also needs `api`, `baseURL` and `models`.

api_key_env.label: Key variable
api_key_env.desc: The variable a gateway route reads its key from, matching its `apiKeyEnv`. Empty: no key is passed.

api_key.label: Gateway key
api_key.desc: The key itself, kept in the keychain and passed to the runtime as the variable above. Empty: that variable is taken from pumi's own environment when it has one.

effort.label: Reasoning effort
effort.desc: An adapter-owned effort id (`off`, `low`, `high`, `max`). Empty: the model's own default.

max_tokens.label: Output tokens
max_tokens.desc: A per-request output-token cap for the pane's agent and its in-process subagents. 0: the model's own default.

cwd.label: Directory
cwd.desc: Where a pane's agent starts when the pane has no directory of its own. Empty: the pane's, else the home directory.
